g.text: Question Paper Management System - Detailed System Architecture
End-to-End Processing Architecture: From Multi-Role Input Ingestion, RAG Semantic Extraction, to AI Synthesis & Output
TIER 1: MULTI-ROLE INPUT INGESTION & USER CONFIGURATION LAYER
User Roles (Admin, HOD, Faculty), Password Policies
PDF / DOCX Course Curriculum & Study Materials
Selection of mapped courses for evaluation
Exam Title, Regulation, Course Code, Max Marks
Sections (A & B), Compulsory vs Choice OR Pairs
Percentage breakdown for L1 to L6 cognitive levels
TIER 2: CLIENT APPLICATION & SECURE API GATEWAY LAYER
⚛️ React.js + Vite Single Page Application (Client UI)
• Role-Based Views: Admin Dashboard, Faculty Content Portal, HOD Generation Studio
• Interactive Controllers: Dynamic Blueprint Customizer, Live Question-by-Question Grading Grid
• Client State: AuthContext, JWT Token Storage, Protected Routes Guard
• Security & RBAC: JWT Verification (@token_required), Role Check (Admin/HOD/Faculty)
• Payload Validators: JNTU Roll No Sanitize, Course Code Generator, Choice Structure Normalizer
TIER 3: CORE INPUT PROCESSING, RAG & OPTIMIZATION PIPELINE (HOW INPUTS ARE PROCESSED)
• Stores vector indices mapped to Course ID
• Bloom's Taxonomy Balancing: L1 (Remember) to L6 (Create)
• Pattern Enforcement: Section A (Mandatory), Section B (OR Choices)
• Injects context + constraints into Google Gemini Model
• Synthesizes unique questions with marking criteria
• Marks summation & pattern validation (e.g. Exactly 70 Marks)
Output: Verified Question Paper Schema & Sections
• Latest record placed at last row
• Master Tables: Users, Roles, Programs, Branches, Regulations, Courses (with prefix + custom suffix), Mappings (PB, BC)
• QP Tables: QuestionPaper (title, marks, sem, pattern_sections JSON, paper_schema JSON, generated_content)
• Evaluation Records: Student (jntu_no, course_code, evaluation_data JSON, marks, FIFO indexed by ID)
Standard university header, course code, time & max marks
• Section-wise Layout with Internal Choices (OR Pairs)
• Balanced Cognitive Levels (Bloom's Taxonomy) & Answer Keys
Total marks scored, percentage, pass/distinction tier
• Chronological FIFO Database Records Table with Edit & Delete
Course-wise QP repository searchable by year & semester
Course materials, download links & faculty assignment registry
